init_map_and_pose: initialize global and local map tensors and sensor pose variables for a given environment index
recenter_local_map_and_pose: re-center the local map by updating its boundaries, origins, content, and local pose for an environment
get_local_map_boundaries: compute local map boundary coordinates from a global sensor location and map size parameters
create_MapSizeParameters: create a MapSizeParameters object with resolution, map size in centimeters, and global downscaling factor
review_map_utils: review the map_utils module for map initialization, recentering, and boundary calculation functions
